{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f'Number of rows: {len(df)}')
print(f'Number of unique patient_id: {df["patient_id"].nunique()}')
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {len(df) - df["patient_id"].nunique()}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check sample_seq for re-testing: any patient with sample_seq > 1?
df_sample_seq = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max()
print(f'Number of patients with multiple sample_seq (re-tested): {df_sample_seq[df_sample_seq > 1].count()}')"}
